description: Sends an invoice in the getpeppr sandbox to the Belgian test receiver 9925:BE0314595348, for your own company or for one of your test customers. Never sends a real invoice. Lines without tax fields get your account's sandbox tax profile. While your sandbox tax profile is unchanged, calling it again with the same arguments returns the same document, never a second one. Returns a documentId to pass to get_document_status. Requires signing in to getpeppr.

invoice.description: An invoice in the getpeppr SDK shape (https://getpeppr.dev/docs/types/). Minimal example: {"number":"INV-001","to":{"name":"SPF Economie (test receiver)","peppolId":"9925:BE0314595348","street":"Rue du Progrès 50","city":"Brussels","postalCode":"1210","country":"BE"},"lines":[{"description":"Consulting","quantity":1,"unitPrice":1000}]}. to.peppolId must be the sandbox test receiver 9925:BE0314595348. Omit "from": the sender is your registered company. Omit the line tax fields (vatRate, vatCategory, taxExemptReason): the server applies your account's sandbox tax profile to lines that carry none.

sender.description: Platform accounts: send as one of your test customers (the legalEntity.id create_test_customer returned). Its tax fields are then yours to set: O with vatRate 0 for a test customer without a VAT number, AE with vatRate 0 for one with a VAT number.

name: send_test_invoice
title: Send a sandbox test invoice
